parameters.help_en: The ID of the AgentCore workspace to which the service endpoint to be created belongs. You can obtain the ID by calling the ListWorkspaces operation
parameters.help_zh: 待创建服务端点所属的 AgentCore 工作空间 ID，可通过 ListWorkspaces 获取
parameters.name: workspace_id

fields.help_en: The saved invocation authentication type. NONE indicates that the endpoint API key is not used. API_KEY indicates that the endpoint API key is used. For AGENT_VERSION endpoints of non-EDGE agents, the actual API key verification is determined by the current inbound authentication configuration of the agent and cannot be determined solely based on this field
fields.help_zh: 保存的调用认证类型：NONE 表示配置为不使用端点 API Key，API_KEY 表示配置为使用端点 API Key。非 EDGE 智能体的 AGENT_VERSION 类型端点，实际 API Key 校验由 Agent 当前入站认证配置决定，不能仅根据该字段判断
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: Sets the invocation authentication configuration saved for the service endpoint, specified by type. For AGENT_VERSION endpoints of non-EDGE agents, the actual API key verification is determined by the current inbound authentication configuration of the agent. The management operation for creating service endpoints still uses AccessKey or STS authentication and RAM authorization
fields.help_zh: 设置服务端点保存的调用认证配置，通过 type 指定。非 EDGE 智能体的 AGENT_VERSION 类型端点，实际 API Key 校验由 Agent 当前入站认证配置决定。创建服务端点的管理接口仍使用 AK 或 STS 认证及 RAM 授权
fields.name: authentication

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable dynamic policies. Required during creation. If omitted during an update, the original value is retained. Disabling it retains existing policies and restores the basic upper and lower limits. Re-enabling it triggers immediate calculation. When finally enabled, policies must not be empty
fields.help_zh: 创建时必填；更新时省略保留原值。关闭保留已有策略并恢复基础上下限，重新开启立即计算；最终开启时 policies 不得为空
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: Required only when validity is set to range. The format is the same as startTime, the seconds are fixed at 00, and it must be later than startTime. The interval does not include the end time. For forever, the start and end times must be omitted. Valid dates and cross-field constraints are verified by the console
fields.help_zh: 仅 validity=range 必填，格式与 startTime 相同，秒位固定 00，必须晚于 startTime；区间不包含结束时刻。forever 必须省略起止时间；合法日期和跨字段约束由 Console 校验
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en: Required. It must be unique and stable within the endpoint. It is generated by the frontend when added, and retained during editing and retries
fields.help_zh: 必填，Endpoint 内唯一且稳定；新增时由前端生成，编辑和重试保留
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: Required. 5 indicates normal, and 10 indicates high priority. New policies default to normal. It must be explicitly provided during submission, and no default value is set for the operation. When the final dynamicPolicy.enabled is true, the validity periods of high-priority policies must not overlap, but end-to-end connection is allowed. Long-term high-priority policies can overlap with other high-priority policies. When disabled, overlapping drafts can be saved, and the final configuration is verified when re-enabled. The validity of other fields and trigger conflicts within the policy are always verified. The priority must be explicitly provided
fields.help_zh: 必填，5 为常规，10 为高优；新增策略默认选择常规，提交时显式携带，不设置接口默认值。最终 dynamicPolicy.enabled=true 时，高优策略之间有效期不得重叠，首尾相接允许，长期高优与其他高优重叠；关闭时允许保存重叠草稿，重新开启时校验最终配置。其他字段合法性与策略内触发冲突始终校验；priority 必须显式提供
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: Required. daily means every day, weekly means every week, and monthly means every month. Only submit the fields corresponding to the cycle
fields.help_zh: 必填。daily 为每天，weekly 为每星期，monthly 为每月；仅提交对应周期的字段
fields.name: repeat

fields.help_en: Required only when validity is set to range. The format is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss in the policy time zone, without a time zone offset, and the seconds are fixed at 00. The interval includes the start time. Editing retains the existing past start time and does not reject updates or retries because it is earlier than the current time
fields.help_zh: 仅 validity=range 必填，策略时区下的 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss，不带时区偏移，秒位固定 00。区间包含开始时刻；编辑保留已有的过去开始时间，不因其早于当前时间拒绝更新或重试
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en: Required. The value ranges from 1 to 100
fields.name: max_instances

fields.help_en: Required. The value ranges from 0 to 100 and must not be greater than maxInstances in the same item
fields.help_zh: 必填，0～100，且不大于同项 maxInstances
fields.name: min_instances

fields.help_en: Required only for each trigger point of monthly. It must be non-empty and deduplicated. The values are integers from 1 to 31. Each row is selected independently. If a date does not exist in a month, it is not triggered and is not postponed to the end of the month. It must be omitted for other cycles
fields.help_zh: 仅 monthly 的每个触发点必填，非空且去重，整数 1～31；每行独立选择，月份不存在的日期不触发，不顺延到月末。其他周期必须省略
fields.name: month_days

fields.help_en: Required. The format is HH:mm:ss. It is interpreted in the time zone of the policy, accurate to the minute, and the seconds are fixed at 00
fields.help_zh: 必填，HH:mm:ss，按所属策略时区解释，精确到分钟，秒位固定 00
fields.name: time

fields.help_en: Required only for each trigger point of weekly. It must be non-empty and deduplicated. The values are integers from 1 to 7, where 1 indicates Monday and 7 indicates Sunday. Each row is selected independently. It must be omitted for other cycles
fields.help_zh: 仅 weekly 的每个触发点必填，非空且去重，整数 1～7，1 为周一、7 为周日；每行独立选择。其他周期必须省略
fields.name: weekdays

fields.help_en: Required and non-empty. Each item must be complete. The day of the week or day of the month is configured independently for each item. Within the same policy, daily policies conflict if the time is the same. Weekly and monthly policies conflict only if the time is the same and the date sets intersect. This is verified by the console
fields.help_zh: 必填且非空，每项必须完整。星期或月日期由每项独立配置。同一策略内，daily 相同 time 冲突，weekly/monthly 仅在 time 相同且日期集合相交时冲突，由 Console 校验
fields.name: time_points

fields.help_en: Required. A valid IANA time zone. All dates and times in this policy are interpreted in this time zone
fields.help_zh: 必填，合法 IANA 时区。本策略所有日期和时间均在该时区下解释
fields.name: time_zone

fields.help_en: Required. forever indicates long-term validity, and range indicates short-term validity. After expiration, the policy and its trigger results exit the current calculation, and the remaining policies are recalculated. If there are no candidates, the basic values are restored, and the saved configurations are not automatically deleted
fields.help_zh: 必填，forever 为长期有效，range 为短期有效。到期后策略及其触发结果退出当前计算并重算剩余策略；无候选恢复基础值，保存的配置不自动删除
fields.name: validity

fields.help_en: Required during creation. If omitted during an update, the original list is retained. If passed, the entire list is replaced and not merged by ID. To clear the list, you must also ensure that the final enabled value is false. Each item must be complete. Conditional requirements and cross-field constraints are verified by the server. The display order does not indicate priority
fields.help_zh: 创建时必填；更新时省略保留原列表，传入即整体替换，不按 id 合并。清空须同时保证最终 enabled=false。每项必须完整，条件必填和跨字段约束由服务端校验；显示顺序不作为优先级
fields.name: policies

fields.help_en: Required. It must include enabled and policies, and is verified by the server. It is independent of the overall automatic elasticity switch
fields.help_zh: 必填，须包含 enabled 和 policies，由服务端校验；与整个自动弹性开关独立
fields.name: dynamic_policy

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the entire automatic elasticity mode. It must be provided when elasticityPolicy is passed and is verified by the server
fields.help_zh: 传入 elasticityPolicy 时必须提供，由服务端校验
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the entire automatic elasticity mode. It must be provided when elasticityPolicy is passed and is verified by the server
fields.help_zh: 传入 elasticityPolicy 时必须提供，由服务端校验
fields.name: max_sandbox_count

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the entire automatic elasticity mode. It must be provided when elasticityPolicy is passed and is verified by the server
fields.help_zh: 传入 elasticityPolicy 时必须提供，由服务端校验
fields.name: min_sandbox_count

fields.help_en: Explicitly provided when creating a service endpoint with elasticity capabilities. The capability scope follows existing rules. Null or partial patches are not accepted. It must include enabled, the basic minSandboxCount and maxSandboxCount, and the complete dynamicPolicy. The basic upper and lower limits are both 0 to 100, and min must be less than or equal to max. To disable dynamic scaling without policies, pass enabled=false and policies=[]. When elasticity initialization is included, clientToken must be provided, and updateElasticity is not passed. Conditional requirements and cross-field constraints are verified by the server
fields.help_zh: 创建具有弹性能力的服务端点时显式提供，能力范围沿用现有规则；不接受 null 或局部 patch。须包含 enabled、基础 minSandboxCount/maxSandboxCount 和完整 dynamicPolicy，基础上下限均为 0～100 且 min≤max。关闭动态且无策略时传 enabled=false、policies=[]。含弹性初始化时必须携带 clientToken，不传 updateElasticity。条件必填和跨字段约束由服务端校验
fields.name: elasticity_policy

fields.help_en: The name of the named service endpoint to be created. For the Router type, the name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens. It must start with a letter or a digit, cannot use the reserved name default, and must be unique within the same agent. The names of Router and hybrid ingress endpoints cannot be changed after creation
fields.help_zh: 待创建的命名服务端点名称。Router 类型名称为 1～128 位小写字母、数字、下划线或短划线，首位须为字母或数字，不能使用保留名称 default，且在同一智能体内唯一；Router 和混合入口端点创建后不支持改名
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable public network inbound access for the service endpoint. If omitted, it is initialized to true. If true or false is passed, the passed value is saved. An explicit null or non-boolean value returns InvalidParameter. Whether public network access is actually enabled is also subject to the public network inbound access limit of the workspace. For more information, see effectivePublicAccessEnabled in the response
fields.help_zh: 省略时按 true 初始化；传 true 或 false 时按传入值保存。显式 null 或非布尔值返回 InvalidParameter。实际是否开放公网还受工作空间公网入向上限约束，见响应中的 effectivePublicAccessEnabled
fields.name: public_access_enabled

fields.help_en: The ID of the agent associated with the AGENT_VERSION routing target. The agent is located in the workspace specified in the request
fields.help_zh: AGENT_VERSION 类型路由目标关联的智能体 ID，该智能体位于请求指定的工作空间内
fields.name: agent_id

fields.help_en: The version of the agent associated with the AGENT_VERSION routing target. Use the agentVersion returned by CreateAgentVersion or ListAgentVersions, which is different from the version name versionName
fields.help_zh: AGENT_VERSION 类型路由目标关联的智能体版本号。使用 CreateAgentVersion 或 ListAgentVersions 返回的 agentVersion，区别于版本名称 versionName
fields.name: agent_version

fields.help_en: The component associated with the TEAM_COLLABORATION routing target. MATRIX_CLIENT indicates the Matrix client ingress, MATRIX_FEDERATION indicates the Matrix federation ingress, and ELEMENT_WEB indicates the Element Web ingress. Service endpoints for collaboration components are created internally by the platform. Do not pass this field when publicly creating an AGENT_VERSION endpoint
fields.help_zh: TEAM_COLLABORATION 类型路由目标关联的组件。MATRIX_CLIENT 表示 Matrix 客户端入口，MATRIX_FEDERATION 表示 Matrix 联邦入口，ELEMENT_WEB 表示 Element Web 入口；协作组件服务端点由平台内部创建。公开创建 AGENT_VERSION 类型端点时不要传入此字段
fields.name: collaboration_component

fields.help_en: The ID of the resource binding associated with the TEAM_COLLABORATION routing target. It is maintained internally by the platform and generated in the format of wrb- followed by a 32-character hexadecimal UUID. Do not pass this field when publicly creating an AGENT_VERSION endpoint
fields.help_zh: TEAM_COLLABORATION 类型路由目标关联的资源绑定 ID，由平台内部维护，生成格式为 wrb- 加 32 位十六进制 UUID。公开创建 AGENT_VERSION 类型端点时不要传入此字段
fields.name: resource_binding_id

fields.help_en: The public create operation only supports AGENT_VERSION, which indicates routing to a specified agent version. TEAM_COLLABORATION indicates a collaboration component. Service endpoints for collaboration components are created internally by the platform
fields.help_zh: 公开创建接口仅支持 AGENT_VERSION，表示路由到指定智能体版本。TEAM_COLLABORATION 表示协作组件，协作组件服务端点由平台内部创建
fields.name: target_type

fields.help_en: Specifies the agent and its version associated with the service endpoint. The routing targets for collaboration components are maintained internally by the platform
fields.help_zh: 指定服务端点关联的智能体及其版本。协作组件的路由目标由平台内部维护
fields.name: target

parameters.help_en: The name, routing target, and invocation authentication configuration of the service endpoint to be created, along with the optional initial elasticity configuration and public access switch
parameters.help_zh: 待创建服务端点的名称、路由目标和调用认证配置，以及可选的初始弹性配置和公网入向开关
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en: Required when elasticity initialization is included. It is verified by the server. The same token and original request are reused for the same retry. If the logical content changes, a new token is used. The same token with different content returns InvalidParameter. The token must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: . _ : -. The scope is the tenant and workspace. The receipt is retained for 7 days from the time of successful acceptance. Replays do not extend the retention period. After expiration, it is verified again as a new submission
parameters.help_zh: 含弹性初始化时必填，由服务端校验。同次重试复用 token 和原请求，逻辑内容变更使用新 token；同 token 不同内容返回 InvalidParameter。token 为 1～128 位英文字母、数字或 ._:-，作用域为租户与 Workspace；回执自成功受理起保留 7 天，重放不续期，到期后按新提交重新校验
parameters.name: client_token

code.description_en: The response code of the request. The value is SUCCESS if the request is successful
code.description_zh: 本次请求的响应码，成功时为 SUCCESS

data.description_en: The service endpoint information returned after a successful creation, including the binding target, saved authentication and elasticity configurations, and current status. The endpoint may still be in the creating state
data.description_zh: 成功创建后返回的服务端点信息，包括绑定目标、保存的认证和弹性配置及当前状态。端点可能仍在创建中

accessUrls.description_en: The list of access URLs for the service endpoint
accessUrls.description_zh: 服务端点的访问地址列表

accessType.description_en: The type of the access URL. Valid values: INTERNET and VPC

status.description_en: The status of the access URL. Valid values: CREATING, READY, and DEGRADED

statusReason.description_en: The reason for the access URL status. The specific reason is returned when the status is abnormal
statusReason.description_zh: 访问地址状态原因。状态异常时返回具体原因
statusReason.example: ServiceEndpoint.Provider.Unavailable: no provider for the target type

authentication.description_en: The authentication configuration of the service endpoint

type.description_en:
The authentication method. Valid values:
NONE: No authentication is required.
API_KEY: Authentication is performed by passing an API key in the x-api-key request header
type.description_zh: 鉴权方式。NONE 表示无需鉴权，API_KEY 表示通过 x-api-key 请求头传递 API Key 进行鉴权

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in UTC format compliant with RFC 3339
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

currentInstances.description_en: The current number of instances. This parameter is read-only. The Get operation queries RM sandboxPhaseCounts.RUNNING based on the endpoint runtimeKey. The Create and Update operations return null. The value is a non-negative integer. If the statistics are unavailable, null is returned. This parameter is not replaced by the base upper and lower limits, target quantity, or READY status. Unavailable statistics do not block submission
currentInstances.description_zh: 只读，Get 按 Endpoint runtimeKey 查询 RM sandboxPhaseCounts.RUNNING；Create/Update 返回 null。非负整数，统计不可获得时返回 null；不以基础上下限、目标数量或 READY 状态替代，统计不可获得不阻塞提交

effectivePublicAccessEnabled.description_en: The combined result of publicAccessEnabled and the workspace-level public access limit. The value is true only when both allow public access. This value only indicates the policy target and does not mean that the public endpoint has been fully provisioned. For the actual status, refer to accessUrls and status
effectivePublicAccessEnabled.description_zh: publicAccessEnabled 与工作空间公网入向上限叠加后的结果：二者均允许时为 true。仅表示策略目标，不代表公网入口已发布完成，实际状态以 accessUrls 与 status 为准
effectivePublicAccessEnabled.title_en: 服务端点公网入向的有效期望值
effectivePublicAccessEnabled.title_zh: 服务端点公网入向的有效期望值

elasticityPolicy.description_en: The configuration used for edit backfill, which is not the currently effective upper and lower limits or the actual number of instances. The Get operation preferentially returns the saved configuration. If no configuration is saved, an endpoint that supports elasticity backfills the base values from the expected runtime frozen configuration or the bound version configuration when the runtime is not yet established, without requiring a successful publication. The value is null when the source is temporarily unavailable or no applicable configuration exists, but the status and statusReason are still returned. The Create and Update operations return only the saved configuration, and the value is null if no configuration is saved. The historical base capacity may exceed 100, and the read value is not truncated
elasticityPolicy.description_zh: 用于编辑回填，不是当前生效上下限或实际实例数。Get 优先返回保存配置；未保存时，支持弹性的 Endpoint 从期望 runtime 冻结配置或尚未建立 runtime 时的绑定版本配置回填基础值，不要求发布成功。来源暂缺或无适用配置时为 null，仍返回 status/statusReason；Create/Update 仅返回已保存配置，未保存时为 null。历史基础容量可超过 100，读取不截断

dynamicPolicy.description_en: The saved dynamic configuration. If the base configuration before the requirement goes online lacks dynamicPolicy, it is supplemented with enabled=false and policies=[]
dynamicPolicy.description_zh: 返回保存的动态配置；需求上线前的基础配置缺 dynamicPolicy 时补为 enabled=false、policies=[]

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether to enable dynamic policies. Required during creation. If omitted during an update, the original value is retained. Disabling it retains existing policies and restores the basic upper and lower limits. Re-enabling it triggers immediate calculation. When finally enabled, policies must not be empty
enabled.description_zh: 创建时必填；更新时省略保留原值。关闭保留已有策略并恢复基础上下限，重新开启立即计算；最终开启时 policies 不得为空

policies.description_en: Required during creation. If omitted during an update, the original list is retained. If passed, the entire list is replaced and not merged by ID. To clear the list, you must also ensure that the final enabled value is false. Each item must be complete. Conditional requirements and cross-field constraints are verified by the server. The display order does not indicate priority
policies.description_zh: 创建时必填；更新时省略保留原列表，传入即整体替换，不按 id 合并。清空须同时保证最终 enabled=false。每项必须完整，条件必填和跨字段约束由服务端校验；显示顺序不作为优先级

endTime.description_en: Required only when validity is set to range. The format is the same as startTime, the seconds are fixed at 00, and it must be later than startTime. The interval does not include the end time. For forever, the start and end times must be omitted. Valid dates and cross-field constraints are verified by the console
endTime.description_zh: 仅 validity=range 必填，格式与 startTime 相同，秒位固定 00，必须晚于 startTime；区间不包含结束时刻。forever 必须省略起止时间；合法日期和跨字段约束由 Console 校验

id.description_en: Required. It must be unique and stable within the endpoint. It is generated by the frontend when added, and retained during editing and retries
id.description_zh: 必填，Endpoint 内唯一且稳定；新增时由前端生成，编辑和重试保留

priority.description_en: Required. 5 indicates normal, and 10 indicates high priority. New policies default to normal. It must be explicitly provided during submission, and no default value is set for the operation. When the final dynamicPolicy.enabled is true, the validity periods of high-priority policies must not overlap, but end-to-end connection is allowed. Long-term high-priority policies can overlap with other high-priority policies. When disabled, overlapping drafts can be saved, and the final configuration is verified when re-enabled. The validity of other fields and trigger conflicts within the policy are always verified. The priority must be explicitly provided
priority.description_zh: 必填，5 为常规，10 为高优；新增策略默认选择常规，提交时显式携带，不设置接口默认值。最终 dynamicPolicy.enabled=true 时，高优策略之间有效期不得重叠，首尾相接允许，长期高优与其他高优重叠；关闭时允许保存重叠草稿，重新开启时校验最终配置。其他字段合法性与策略内触发冲突始终校验；priority 必须显式提供

repeat.description_en: Required. daily means every day, weekly means every week, and monthly means every month. Only submit the fields corresponding to the cycle
repeat.description_zh: 必填。daily 为每天，weekly 为每星期，monthly 为每月；仅提交对应周期的字段

startTime.description_en: Required only when validity is set to range. The format is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss in the policy time zone, without a time zone offset, and the seconds are fixed at 00. The interval includes the start time. Editing retains the existing past start time and does not reject updates or retries because it is earlier than the current time
startTime.description_zh: 仅 validity=range 必填，策略时区下的 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss，不带时区偏移，秒位固定 00。区间包含开始时刻；编辑保留已有的过去开始时间，不因其早于当前时间拒绝更新或重试

timePoints.description_en: Required and non-empty. Each item must be complete. The day of the week or day of the month is configured independently for each item. Within the same policy, daily policies conflict if the time is the same. Weekly and monthly policies conflict only if the time is the same and the date sets intersect. This is verified by the console
timePoints.description_zh: 必填且非空，每项必须完整。星期或月日期由每项独立配置。同一策略内，daily 相同 time 冲突，weekly/monthly 仅在 time 相同且日期集合相交时冲突，由 Console 校验

maxInstances.description_en: Required. The value ranges from 1 to 100

minInstances.description_en: Required. The value ranges from 0 to 100 and must not be greater than maxInstances in the same item
minInstances.description_zh: 必填，0～100，且不大于同项 maxInstances

monthDays.description_en: Required only for each trigger point of monthly. It must be non-empty and deduplicated. The values are integers from 1 to 31. Each row is selected independently. If a date does not exist in a month, it is not triggered and is not postponed to the end of the month. It must be omitted for other cycles
monthDays.description_zh: 仅 monthly 的每个触发点必填，非空且去重，整数 1～31；每行独立选择，月份不存在的日期不触发，不顺延到月末。其他周期必须省略

items.description_en: The day of the month. The value ranges from 1 to 31. If the date does not exist in the current month, it is not triggered
items.description_zh: 月内日期，范围为 1～31，所在月份不存在的日期不触发
items.title_en: 月内日期，范围为 1～31，所在月份不存在的日期不触发。
items.title_zh: 月内日期，范围为 1～31，所在月份不存在的日期不触发。

time.description_en: Required. The format is HH:mm:ss. It is interpreted in the time zone of the policy, accurate to the minute, and the seconds are fixed at 00
time.description_zh: 必填，HH:mm:ss，按所属策略时区解释，精确到分钟，秒位固定 00

weekdays.description_en: Required only for each trigger point of weekly. It must be non-empty and deduplicated. The values are integers from 1 to 7, where 1 indicates Monday and 7 indicates Sunday. Each row is selected independently. It must be omitted for other cycles
weekdays.description_zh: 仅 weekly 的每个触发点必填，非空且去重，整数 1～7，1 为周一、7 为周日；每行独立选择。其他周期必须省略

items.description_en: The day of the week. 1 indicates Monday, and 7 indicates Sunday
items.description_zh: 星期序号，1 为周一，7 为周日
items.title_en: 星期序号，1 为周一，7 为周日。
items.title_zh: 星期序号，1 为周一，7 为周日。

timeZone.description_en: Required. A valid IANA time zone. All dates and times in this policy are interpreted in this time zone
timeZone.description_zh: 必填，合法 IANA 时区。本策略所有日期和时间均在该时区下解释

validity.description_en: Required. forever indicates long-term validity, and range indicates short-term validity. After expiration, the policy and its trigger results exit the current calculation, and the remaining policies are recalculated. If there are no candidates, the basic values are restored, and the saved configurations are not automatically deleted
validity.description_zh: 必填，forever 为长期有效，range 为短期有效。到期后策略及其触发结果退出当前计算并重算剩余策略；无候选恢复基础值，保存的配置不自动删除

enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the elasticity policy is enabled. This parameter is independent of dynamicPolicy.enabled. If this parameter is omitted during an update, the original value is retained
enabled.description_zh: 与 dynamicPolicy.enabled 独立。更新时省略表示保留原值
enabled.title_en: 是否开启整个自动弹性模式
enabled.title_zh: 是否开启整个自动弹性模式

maxSandboxCount.description_en: The saved or backfilled base maximum number of instances, which is not less than minSandboxCount. The historical value may exceed 100, and the read value is not truncated. The base value is used when dynamic scaling is disabled or no candidates are available
maxSandboxCount.description_zh: 保存或回填的基础最大实例数，不小于 minSandboxCount。历史值可超过 100，读取不截断；动态关闭或无候选时使用基础值
maxSandboxCount.title_en: 保存的基础最大实例数
maxSandboxCount.title_zh: 保存的基础最大实例数

minSandboxCount.description_en: The saved or backfilled base minimum number of instances, which is a non-negative integer and not greater than maxSandboxCount. The historical value may exceed 100, and the read value is not truncated. A newly written complete configuration must still meet the requirement of 0 to 100
minSandboxCount.description_zh: 保存或回填的基础最小实例数，非负且不大于 maxSandboxCount。历史值可超过 100，读取不截断；新写入的完整配置仍须满足 0～100
minSandboxCount.title_en: 保存的基础最小实例数
minSandboxCount.title_zh: 保存的基础最小实例数

elasticityPolicy.title_en: 服务端点保存的完整弹性配置
elasticityPolicy.title_zh: 服务端点保存的完整弹性配置

endpointType.description_en:
The type of the service endpoint. Valid values:
DEFAULT: The default endpoint created and maintained by the platform.
NAMED: The named endpoint explicitly created by the user
endpointType.description_zh: 服务端点类型。DEFAULT 表示由平台创建并维护的默认端点，NAMED 表示用户显式创建的命名端点

name.description_en: The name of the service endpoint. The name must be unique within the workspace and be 1 to 128 characters in length
name.description_zh: 服务端点名称。在工作空间内唯一，长度为 1~128 个字符

publicAccessEnabled.description_en: The expected public access setting configured by the user on the service endpoint. For historical service endpoints that have not been configured, this parameter returns true. This value only indicates the configuration expectation. To check whether the actual public endpoint is available, refer to accessUrls and status
publicAccessEnabled.description_zh: 用户在服务端点上设置的公网入向期望；未设置过的历史服务端点按 true 返回。仅表示配置期望，实际公网地址是否可用以 accessUrls 与 status 为准
publicAccessEnabled.title_en: 服务端点公网入向开关的期望值
publicAccessEnabled.title_zh: 服务端点公网入向开关的期望值

regionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the service endpoint resides
regionId.description_zh: 服务端点所在的地域 ID

serviceEndpointId.description_en: The ID of the service endpoint

status.description_en: The status of the service endpoint. Valid values: CREATING, READY, UPDATING, DEGRADED, DISABLED, and DELETING

statusReason.description_en: The reason for the service endpoint status. The specific reason is returned when the status is abnormal
statusReason.description_zh: 服务端点状态原因。状态异常时返回具体原因
statusReason.example: ServiceEndpoint.Provider.Unavailable: no provider for the target type

target.description_en: The target routing configuration of the service endpoint
target.description_zh: 服务端点的目标路由配置

agentId.description_en: The ID of the target agent. This parameter is returned when the target type is AGENT_VERSION
agentId.description_zh: 目标智能体 ID。目标类型为 AGENT_VERSION 时返回

agentVersion.description_en: The version number of the target agent. This parameter is returned when the target type is AGENT_VERSION
agentVersion.description_zh: 目标智能体版本号。目标类型为 AGENT_VERSION 时返回

collaborationComponent.description_en: The type of the collaboration component. This parameter is returned when the target type is TEAM_COLLABORATION
collaborationComponent.description_zh: 协作组件类型。目标类型为 TEAM_COLLABORATION 时返回

resourceBindingId.description_en: The ID of the workspace resource binding associated with the target collaboration component. This parameter is returned when the target type is TEAM_COLLABORATION
resourceBindingId.description_zh: 目标协作组件关联的工作空间资源绑定 ID。目标类型为 TEAM_COLLABORATION 时返回

targetType.description_en: The target type. Valid values: AGENT_VERSION and TEAM_COLLABORATION

updatedAt.description_en: The time of the last modification in UTC format compliant with RFC 3339
updatedAt.description_zh: 最近一次修改的时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the request. The value is 200 if the request is successful
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次请求对应的 HTTP 状态码，成功时为 200

message.description_en: The response message of the request. The value is success if the request is successful
message.description_zh: 本次请求的响应消息，成功时为 success

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于定位和排查问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates that the creation request is accepted, but it does not mean that the endpoint deployment is complete. To confirm the deployment result, check data.status and data.accessUrls
success.description_zh: true 表示创建请求已成功受理，不代表端点部署完成；部署结果须结合 data.status 和 data.accessUrls 查询确认
